mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.message_id AS messageId, r.user_id AS userId, u.username, r.content, r.create_time AS createTime FROM reply r LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE r.message_id = #{messageId} AND r.status = 1 ORDER BY r.create_time ASC

SELECT r.id, r.message_id AS messageId, r.user_id AS userId, u.username, r.content, r.create_time AS createTime, r.visibility, r.visible_usernames AS visibleUsernames FROM reply r LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON r.user_id = u.id
r.message_id = #{messageId} AND r.status = 1
AND ( r.visibility = 0
OR r.user_id = #{currentUserId}
OR (r.visibility = 2 AND FIND_IN_SET(#{currentUsername}, r.visible_usernames))
)
ORDER BY r.create_time ASC
